response.reason: The polynomial coefficient 0.16666 (instead of 1/6 ≈ 0.1666667) introduces an error of about 6.7e-6 in the cubic term; at the worst reduced argument |r| ≈ 0.3466 (x near ±0.5·ln2 plus multiples, e.g. the FP16 value 0.34668 giving r ≈ -0.3465 with scale 2), this yields ~5.6e-7 absolute error from that defect alone, plus ~2.4e-7 truncation error (r^7/5040 term omitted), totaling ~8e-7 against an allowed tolerance of only ~5.2e-7 for target ≈ 0.414. This relative error (~1.5-2e-6) exceeds the 1e-6+1e-7 budget on a range of legal inputs, so the implementation violates the accuracy contract.
